nodes.name: pch.h
nodes.summary: Stable precompiled header that pulls Win32, STL, Direct3D 11, FBX SDK, Effekseer, ImGui/ImGuizmo, and core engine headers so they compile once per build.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN and NOMINMAX, then using-declares std::min/std::max and namespace DirectX.

nodes.name: ui_prefs.json
nodes.summary: Editor UI preference file that stores ImGui zoom as uiZoomPercent 175, loaded from rom/editor when a content project opens.
